articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock
articles.snippet: Fidelity's FBTC and Grayscale's GBTC saw outflows of $83.6 million and $54.9 million, respectively.

articles.title: Netflix FTX trailer was ‘enough to upset me’ in first 30 seconds: former FTX COO
articles.snippet: Constance Wang criticized the streamer’s portrayal of her former FTX colleagues as not matching her own experience with Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison.

articles.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
articles.snippet: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.
